title: Guard options 2: gentler fixes
about: Guard options, second page (10-21). On the first page the fixes were 'mostly a bit off or too bright': the guard moves a setting only until the picture is just under the limit, and room light brightens everything. Here: a too-bright picture (Gallery track, exposure +2.5) fixed by lowering exposure only until nothing new blows (W3), or highlights then exposure to the same aim (W4), against the guard now (W1). A too-dark one (Gallery track, Classic raking, exposure −0.8, no room light) fixed with room light up to 1.0 (D4, your maybe), with the output black point only (D5: lifts the deepest tones, leaves the rest), with Lift darks only (D6: darks most, whites untouched), or allowing 0.5% newly crushed, the level your favourite looks already have, with room light (D7) or the black point (D8). Hold the picture to flip to the unfixed version.
